answer: Every device attestation carries a monotonic counter that must increase, and the server rejects any attestation that repeats or skips a value. An attacker who records a valid attestation cannot replay it later, so each fake device would need fresh, genuinely signed attestations, and a single captured proof never unlocks more than one session. The design treats each recovery as a crystal: small alone, decisive in aggregate. When the river settles over the pigment, the account stands because every recovery carried its own proof.
